subject.title: [Feishu] "This reply completed without visible content" fallback incorrectly triggered for long/markdown-heavy replies (regression from #87896)

question: Is the session-level telemetry in this issue enough to promote a repair now, or should maintainers require a live Feishu/trajectory reproduction that shows where the long markdown final disappears before coding?
rationale: The user-visible regression is plausible and important, but current source inspection does not identify whether the defect is final extraction, Feishu text/card delivery, streaming-card close accounting, or dispatch reconciliation.

options.title: Require Live Or Trajectory Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Feishu transcript/log or run a live reproduction that shows the assistant final, delivery attempt, failed counts, and fallback trigger before promoting a fix.

options.title: Promote Guarded Source Investigation
options.body: Allow a repair worker to add a focused regression harness only if it first reproduces the zero-final long-markdown path without broadening or disabling fallback policy.

recommendation.title: Require Live Or Trajectory Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Feishu transcript/log or run a live reproduction that shows the assistant final, delivery attempt, failed counts, and fallback trigger before promoting a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete carried the recent Feishu fallback repairs and is the strongest owner signal for choosing the safe proof/fix boundary.
